title: Musa beer on TikTok
category: Social Media Strategy · Content Strategy · Creative Concept
intro: Developed during my postgraduate studies at IADE together with Sara, Vicente and Jorge, this group project explored how Portuguese craft beer brand MUSA could enter TikTok with a presence that felt unmistakably MUSA. The objective was to build brand awareness, engage a younger audience and create opportunities for community participation, without simply translating MUSA's existing social media presence onto another platform.

sections.heading: The Challenge
sections.text: MUSA already had a distinctive personality and strong presence across platforms such as Instagram and Facebook. TikTok, however, was largely unexplored territory. The challenge was not simply to make MUSA visible on TikTok, but to understand what the brand could contribute to the platform: how could its irreverent personality, connection to music and culture, and existing community translate into content people would actually want to watch and participate in?

sections.heading: My role
sections.text: My contribution focused on research, strategy and creative development. I worked on audience and competitor analysis, TikTok trends and positioning, and helped shape the content pillars and overall campaign structure. From there, I contributed to developing recurring content formats, seasonal activations, influencer ideas, hashtag challenges and community-led concepts designed to turn MUSA's audience from viewers into participants.

sections.heading: The Strategy
sections.text:
Our research pointed towards an audience that was urban, creative, culturally engaged and drawn to brands that felt authentic rather than overly polished. Instead of treating TikTok as another advertising channel, we approached it as an extension of MUSA's world, a place where beer could become the starting point for conversations around music, food, creativity and everyday culture.

Three themes became the foundation of the strategy: food, music and freestyle

items.title: Food
items.text: Recipes, pairings, chefs and food culture bringing MUSA into the moments where people eat, share and discover.

items.title: Music
items.text: Live sessions, playlists, festivals and emerging artists, reinforcing the connection between MUSA and music culture.

items.title: Freestyle
items.text: Art, humour, spontaneous formats and community creativity the space where the brand could experiment most freely.

sections.heading: From Strategy to Content
sections.text: Alongside larger campaigns, we developed recurring formats that could give MUSA a consistent reason to show up throughout the year.

items.title: Behind the Scenes
items.text: Everyday life inside the brewery and taprooms, from the people behind MUSA to production processes, customer interactions and spontaneous moments.

items.title: MUSA tips
items.text: Short, useful and playful content built around the brand, such as “How to pour the perfect beer?”

items.title: Mini Interviews
items.text: Fast conversations around culture, music, food and other subjects relevant to MUSA's community.
UGC, reactions and challenges designed to turn the audience from viewers into active participants in MUSA's content.
items.title: Community Content

left.title: Spring / Summer
left.text:
Connect MUSA with festivals, outdoor music, rooftop sessions and the social side of the brand.

Open Mic MUSA · Behind the Scenes · Mini Acoustic Sessions · What's Your Vibe with MUSA? · MUSA Filter · Collaborative Playlists

right.title: Fall / Winter
right.text:
Position MUSA as a natural companion to comfort food, homemade dishes and winter street food.

Recipes with MUSA · Chefs × Local Foodies · Wintery Combos · One MUSA, A Thousand Dishes

sections.heading: #MUSACREATIVE
sections.text:
One of the ideas behind the strategy was to give people a reason to create with MUSA rather than simply consume its content.

#MusaCreative invited the community to take something from the MUSA universe — a beer, taproom detail, piece of music, quote or visual — and turn it into something of their own.

Music. Dance. Food. Urban art. Whatever creativity looked like to them.

The strongest contributions could then be amplified through MUSA's own channels and rewarded, creating a loop between brand content and community creativity.

sections.heading: Musa as a Canvas
sections.text:
Art was imagined as a year-round expression of MUSA's identity, connecting the digital strategy back to the creative communities surrounding the brand.

The concept included MUSA in Spray, collaborations with artists for limited-edition cans and timelapse content documenting murals and creative processes.

sections.heading: Takeaway
sections.text:
This project was an exercise in translating an established brand into a platform with its own language and culture.

Rather than asking “What should MUSA post on TikTok?”, we approached the challenge by asking “What could MUSA become on TikTok?”

The result was a strategy built around participation, recurring formats and cultural moments — designed to give the brand room to experiment without losing what already made it recognisable.
